description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'BuzzFeedFilterParams' used for filtering parameters related to Buzz feeds in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for user employee number and share ID, along with allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: BuzzFeedFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to set filtering parameters for Buzz feed retrieval, including sorting options and specific filters like share ID and user employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: setAuthUserEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the share, if set.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the share.
